titel: The Case of the Silent Bell
text:
Nora and Tom have a small detective club in their town. One Monday, Mrs Green, the owner of the bakery, asks them for help. Every morning, someone takes a loaf of bread from her shop, but the door is always locked.

On Tuesday night, Nora and Tom watch the bakery. At five o'clock in the morning, they hear a small bell. It is the bell on the back window! Tom looks closer and sees a little hand. It belongs to a boy with a bag.

The boy's name is Max. He is eight years old, and he is very hungry. His family has no money this week. Max climbs through the small window every morning because he is too shy to ask for help.

Mrs Green is not angry. She smiles and says, "Next time, just knock on the door." From that day, Max gets a free breakfast every morning, and Nora and Tom have solved another case.

aufgaben.frage: Who asks the detectives for help?
What does someone take from the bakery every morning?
Mrs Green says: "Next time, just ___ on the door."
